title: Dual Lane Racer
description: Command two speeding sports cars simultaneously on parallel neon highways—dodge roadblocks and scoop every fuel circle in an intense split-brain reflex test.
controls: Tap the left half to switch the left car's lane and tap the right half to switch the right car's lane.

zh-CN.title: 双手极速赛车
zh-CN.description: 魔性左右脑互搏挑战双手极速赛车：同时操控红蓝两辆跑车在四车道狂飙，吃金币躲路障，极度考验反应力！
zh-CN.controls: 点击左侧屏幕切换左车车道、点击右侧切换右车车道，同时避开方障收集圆点。
